welcome_subtitle: The definitive platform for gaining mass.
other_options_coming_soon: More sign-in options are on the way.
agree_prefix: BY CONTINUING YOU AGREE TO THE
baseline_subtitle:
Accurate metrics ensure precise
progression tracking.
baseline_footnote: Your body composition drives every number that follows. Tap any field to adjust it.
username_invalid: Use 3-50 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only.
username_taken_error: That username is already taken. Try another.
activity_level_subtitle:
Be honest here. Most people overestimate,
and an inflated burn rate means a target
you never actually hit.
sedentary_desc: Desk job, little to no exercise.
extra_active_desc: Physical job and hard daily training.
target_pace_subtitle: Set the weight you're chasing and how fast you intend to get there.
lean_bulk_hint: This pace keeps gains lean. Muscle is built slowly; anything faster is mostly fat.
lean_bulk_warning: Above 0.5 kg (1 lb) per week, the extra weight is usually fat rather than muscle. Consider easing off for a leaner bulk.
target_below_current: Your target needs to be above your current mass of {weight}.
calorie_goal_desc: Fuel for maximum growth. Hit this target daily to ensure constant surplus and brutal strength gains.
onboarding_error_incomplete: Some details are missing. Go back and complete the previous steps.
home_placeholder_body: Your plan is saved. The dashboard, food logging and progress tracking land here next.
section_coming_soon: This section is on the way.
chart_needs_more_data: Log another weigh-in to see your trend.
nutrition_plan_desc: Calculated from your metrics at a {activity} lifestyle. Hit this daily to keep the surplus consistent.
profile_missing: We couldn't find your profile. Finish onboarding to create it.
nutrition_plan_desc_pace: Calculated from your metrics at a {activity} lifestyle, targeting +{pace} {unit} per week.
plan_stale_notice: Your weight has caught up with this target, so it no longer buys a surplus. Recalculate to keep gaining.
recalculate_desc: Recomputed against your current weight. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
save_failed: Couldn't save that. Check your connection and try again.
insight_first_weigh_in_body: One number is all it takes to start the trend. Everything else on this screen builds on it.
insight_weigh_in_due_body: It has been {days} days. Step on the scale first thing tomorrow and the trend stays honest.
insight_consistency_body: {count} weigh-ins logged. The trend is only as good as the habit behind it.
insight_target_reached_body: You are at {target} kg. Set a new target, or ease back to maintenance and hold it.
insight_plan_stale_body: At {weight} kg your body burns what your target feeds it, so there is no surplus left. Recalculate to keep gaining.
insight_pace_fast_body: +{rate} kg a week is above the {ceiling} kg lean ceiling. More than this tends to arrive as fat — consider easing the surplus.
insight_pace_stalled_body: No gain over your recent weigh-ins. Either the food is not going in, or the target needs to go up.
insight_pace_behind_body: Averaging +{rate} kg a week against a +{target} kg target. One more solid meal a day usually closes that gap.
insight_protein_body: {grams} g today — roughly {perMeal} g across {meals} meals. Build each meal around it and the rest is easier.
insight_water_body: About {glasses} glasses at your bodyweight, and more on training days. Being under makes you feel flat and hungry.
insight_weigh_method_body: First thing in the morning, after the toilet, before food or drink. Same conditions each time is what makes the line mean something.
insight_move_body: Twenty minutes lifts what you burn, so more of what you eat has somewhere useful to go.
insight_sleep_body: Seven to nine hours. Growth happens between sessions, not during them, and short nights blunt both appetite and recovery.
insight_eat_consistently_body: Weekends included. A surplus you hit five days out of seven is not the surplus you planned for.
insight_water_body_oz: About {glasses} glasses at your bodyweight, and more on training days. Being under makes you feel flat and hungry.
